responsibility: This header provides the VxWorks-specific AArch64 subtarget configuration. It overrides the generic AArch64 driver specs with VxWorks link, library, start/end file, preprocessing, and profiling settings; defines VxWorks-specific preprocessor builtins and stack-check policy; declares the LLVM-based VxWorks personality; and adjusts AArch64 ABI details such as the static-chain register because VxWorks reserves x18 as the thread control block pointer.
